note: Subject layer of the faction building samples of bead pulp_wars-xdh.1 (docs/art/FACTION_BUILDINGS.md). Each line names its own materials and colours, because the classes used here skip the faction layer. Exploration only.

subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM/GRAVEYARD: Subject: a small old graveyard: three straight horizontal strips of dark grey-brown earth, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the strips; on each strip stands one row of five small dark slate-grey stone gravestones side by side, each a simple upright slab with a pointed top and a tiny carved cross, with a low mound of dark earth in front of it, and a few tiny pale violet flowers; dark slate grey, charcoal and dusty grey-brown only. Gravestones and earth only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM/MUSHROOMS: Subject: a small mushroom farm: three straight horizontal strips of dark brown peat soil, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the strips; on each strip grows one row of five plump round mushrooms side by side, with broad smooth tan and russet-brown caps and short pale cream stalks, and a few small mushrooms between the big ones. Mushrooms and soil only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL/SOLAR: Subject: a solar power collector: three big flat rectangular solar panels of dark navy-blue glass divided into a grid of small square cells by thin silver lines, tilted up toward the sky on slender polished chrome stands, side by side in a row, each on short dark gunmetal feet, with one short chrome mast between them topped by one small hot magenta pink light; wide and low, like a toy. Machine only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL/GRINDSTONE: Subject: a stone-age grinding mill: one huge round flat grey millstone with a hole in its centre resting flat on three squat dark basalt stones, a thick rough wooden pole through its hole as a lever, and a small lean-to shelter of tawny hide stretched over curved pale bone poles behind it, with a woven basket of grain beside the stone; wide and low; no metal anywhere. Buildings only.
subjects.TERRAIN:GRASS/UNDEAD: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short, slightly withered lawn grass seen from directly above, one even calm cool grey-green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely all over, nothing else.
subjects.TERRAIN:GRASS/UNDEAD_LEAVES: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short, slightly withered lawn grass seen from directly above, one even calm cool grey-green base colour with small darker grass tufts and a very few tiny dark dusky-purple fallen leaves scattered evenly and sparsely all over, nothing else.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL/BONE_MILL: Subject: a spooky old windmill: one round tower of dark slate-grey stone with a small dark door and one small glowing violet window, a near-black charcoal cone roof, and four big sail arms of dark wood with ragged torn charcoal-grey cloth full of holes, set in a big X on the front and wider than the tower; a few pale ivory bones leaning at its foot; no fence, no field. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM/HYDROPONIC: Subject: a small hydroponic farm: three straight horizontal troughs of polished silver chrome, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the troughs; in each trough grows one row of five round leafy green vegetables side by side, each under its own small clear pale glass dome with one white highlight. Troughs, plants and domes only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:SAWMILL/CHOPPING_BLOCK: Subject: a stone-age wood chopping camp: one huge stone axe with a grey flint head lashed to a thick wooden handle, stuck upright in a wide tree stump, as tall as the image and the biggest thing in it; beside it a neat pile of pale split logs showing their round pale ends, and behind it a small lean-to of tawny hide on pale bone poles; wide and low; no metal and no saw blade anywhere. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:FARM/FROST_GARDEN: Subject: a small winter garden: three straight horizontal banks of white snow with pale blue shadows, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the banks; in each bank grows one row of five round hardy cabbages side by side, a cold blue-green with pale frosted leaf edges. Snow and cabbages only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL/STEAM_PUMP: Subject: a steam pump house: one squat round boiler tower of riveted copper on a short grey stone footing, with a domed copper top, one white-faced pressure gauge, a tall dark iron chimney puffing one small puff of white steam, and one big brass cog wheel turning on its side beside a thick copper pipe; chunky and low. Buildings only.
